IT operations

IT Incident Lab

I built a browser lab for practicing IT incident triage with simulated metrics, logs, traces and change records.

Independent project

The problem

When a service fails or slows down, several things can look like the cause. I wanted a way to practice sorting through those signals and explaining what the evidence supports.

The decision

I built the demo and the incident-triage skill around the same cases. In Codex and Claude Code, the skill uses the records you provide to summarize the impact, build a timeline with source references, rank possible causes and suggest a read-only check.

What you can try

Investigate a checkout outage where only some payments fail, or find out why search slows down while request volume stays steady. Use the guided replay to inspect the evidence, then reveal the case answer to compare it with your own reasoning.
